description: This file implements a service for managing verifiable credentials (VCs) and workflows, including generation, verification, chain retrieval, and comprehensive validation for execution and workflow VCs within an agent system. It interacts with DID services, storage, and cryptographic signing and verification, encapsulating complex logic for integrity, security, and compliance checks.

classes.name: VCService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing verifiable credentials, including creation, verification, chain retrieval, and comprehensive validation.

methods.name: NewVCService
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new VCService with configuration, DID service, and storage provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the storage for VC management.

methods.name: GetDIDService
methods.description: Returns the DID service instance used for DID operations.

methods.name: IsExecutionVCEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether execution verifiable credential generation is enabled.

methods.name: ShouldPersistExecutionVC
methods.description: Decides if execution VCs should be persisted based on configuration.

methods.name: GetWorkflowVCStatusSummaries
methods.description: Returns lightweight summaries of VC statuses for given workflows.

methods.name: GenerateExecutionVC
methods.description: Creates a verifiable credential for an execution, signing and optionally storing it.

methods.name: VerifyVC
methods.description: Verifies a given verifiable credential for authenticity and integrity.

methods.name: GetWorkflowVCChain
methods.description: Retrieves the full chain of VCs associated with a specific workflow.

methods.name: CreateWorkflowVC
methods.description: Creates a workflow-level verifiable credential aggregating multiple execution VCs.

methods.name: createVCDocument
methods.description: Constructs a VC document for an execution, including relevant metadata and cryptographic proof.

methods.name: signVC
methods.description: Signs a VC document with the caller’s private key.

methods.name: verifyVCSignature
methods.description: Verifies the cryptographic signature of a VC document.

methods.name: hashData
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of input data if hashing is enabled.

methods.name: generateVCID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a VC.

methods.name: generateWorkflowVCDocument
methods.description: On-demand creation of a Workflow VC with current execution states and signatures.

methods.name: createWorkflowVCDocument
methods.description: Constructs the VC document for a workflow, including metadata and context.

methods.name: signWorkflowVC
methods.description: Signs a Workflow VC document with its issuer’s private key.

methods.name: determineWorkflowStatus
methods.description: Assesses overall workflow status based on contained execution VCs.

methods.name: countCompletedSteps
methods.description: Counts how many execution VCs have succeeded.

methods.name: QueryExecutionVCs
methods.description: Fetches execution VCs matching certain filters.

methods.name: GetExecutionVCByExecutionID
methods.description: Retrieves an execution VC by its execution identifier.

methods.name: ListWorkflowVCs
methods.description: Lists all stored workflow VCs.

methods.name: collectDIDResolutionBundle
methods.description: Gathers and resolves all unique DIDs involved in a VC chain for offline verification.

methods.name: VerifyExecutionVCComprehensive
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive, multi-faceted verification of an execution VC, including integrity, security, and compliance.

methods.name: performIntegrityChecks
methods.description: Runs various checks to verify data consistency and integrity of an execution VC.

methods.name: performSecurityAnalysis
methods.description: Performs security-focused analysis on an execution VC for signatures, tampering, and authenticity.

methods.name: performComplianceChecks
methods.description: Checks VC compliance with standards like W3C and AgentField.

methods.name: validateTimestamp
methods.description: Validates the issuance timestamp of a VC.

methods.name: validateVCStructure
methods.description: Ensures that the VC structure contains all required fields.

methods.name: detectTamperEvidence
methods.description: Detects signs of tampering by comparing metadata and cryptographic signatures.

methods.name: checkW3CCompliance
methods.description: Verifies whether a VC adheres to W3C standards.

methods.name: checkAgentFieldStandardCompliance
methods.description: Checks if a VC conforms to the AgentField standard.

methods.name: calculateOverallScore
methods.description: Computes an overall verification score based on multiple criteria and issues.

methods.name: isStatusConsistent
methods.description: Checks whether execution status in metadata and VC are aligned.

methods.name: VerifyWorkflowVCComprehensive
methods.description: Performs an extensive verification of the entire workflow VC chain, including all execution VCs and the workflow VC itself.

methods.name: verifyWorkflowVCSignature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a workflow VC document.

methods.name: checkWorkflowVCCompliance
methods.description: Checks if a workflow VC meets the AgentField standards.
